title: Beginner Full Workout
description: A complete 25-minute starter session: dribbling, form shooting, layups, passing, and defense basics — everything a new player needs.

items.name: Pound dribble warm-up
items.detail: Stationary pound dribbles: 30 seconds right hand, 30 left, 30 alternating. Eyes up.

items.name: Crossover basics
items.detail: Low stationary crossovers: 1 minute. Then walking crossovers down the court and back.

items.name: Form shooting
items.detail: One-hand shots from 4 feet: 5 makes each side and middle. Hold the follow-through.

items.name: Right-hand layups
items.detail: Dribble from the wing and finish right-hand layups: 5 makes. Right hand, left foot.

items.name: Left-hand layups
items.detail: Same from the left side: 5 makes with your left hand. It's okay if it's ugly — reps fix it.

items.name: Passing against the wall
items.detail: Chest passes and bounce passes against a wall: 20 of each, stepping into every pass.

items.name: Defensive slides
items.detail: Lane slides in a low stance: down and back twice. Stay low, don't cross your feet.

items.name: Free-throw finish
items.detail: 10 free throws. Pick a simple routine (two dribbles, breathe, shoot) and use it every time.

tips: Master the basics before adding anything fancy — fundamentals win games.
Your weak hand deserves half your practice time. It feels awkward now; it won't in a month.
Rest 30-60 seconds between blocks if you need it. Quality reps beat tired reps.
Do this workout 3 times a week and you will be shocked how fast you improve.
